claim_ceiling: Fixture semantics only. No flight, marine, environmental, cost, calibration, manufacturing, safety, or regulatory capability is established.
oracle_rule_order: Reject known prohibited site/data use, exceeded ecological or operating envelope, invalid coordinate reference, insufficient energy reserve, unavailable recovery, incompatible payload, known absent local failsafe during communications partition, an estimated value claimed as measured, sensor timeout coerced to zero, and hardware/configuration evidence mismatch.

Abstain for unknown site/operating/permission evidence, stale/missing/failed calibration, ambiguous coordinates, uncertain/insufficient energy evidence where not known to be insufficient, unknown recovery or compatibility, unknown local failsafe, unestablished offline policy, unknown data rights, invalid/stale source data, unknown configuration match, or unknown reference quality.
Prefer a lower-complexity baseline only when its sufficiency is declared and all previous hard-feasibility/evidence gates are satisfied.
Permit degraded planning under communications partition only when a tested local failsafe and valid offline/store-and-forward policy are declared.
Otherwise admit only to the next declared review stage, never directly to physical execution.
implementation_binding: The future qualifier must derive dispositions from raw facts independently and must not trust expected_disposition or expected_reason_codes as its own answer.
